name: agent-vision-toolkit
role: Five local CLIs that give a text-only agent eyes.
capability: Local vision CLIs: glance (describe/ask/OCR an image), ground (locate a target, pixel box), detect (element inventory), trace (image to SVG geometry), crop (cut a pixel box to a file), and scripts/html_shot.py (HTML file to image). Use for any task involving an image — questions, text, splitting and transcribing long screenshots or chat histories, locating elements, comparing, rebuilding as HTML/SVG, digitizing a sketch or diagram, reading values off a chart, operating a GUI from screenshots — and to re-check an image yourself when a description you were given lacks a detail.
when_to_use: 任务涉及图像：描述/提问/OCR（glance）、定位（ground）、清点（detect）、轮廓几何（trace）、裁剪（crop）、长截图拆分 OCR、HTML→截图（html_shot.py）等，按 vendor 问句-工具表选型
when_not_to_use: 任务无图像输入/输出（纯文本/代码任务）
视觉配置缺失（五 CLI 依赖共享 vision config：VISION_API_KEY/VISION_BASE_URL/VISION_MODEL 未配置）时
verification: 产物为五 CLI 真实执行的坐标/框/文件等输出（坐标在 0-1000 网格上按图换算，非像素精确；像素级精确走 trace）；vendor 纪律：有内置工具的像素工作禁用 Pillow 手写重复实现；S3 marker（OmniParser/UI-TARS）+消费锚点机验
